mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id, name, template_title, status, version, format_version, structured_current, last_mode, markdown_content, created_by, published_at, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.ccct_profiles WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND id = #{profileId}

SELECT id, course_id, name, template_title, status, version, format_version, structured_current, last_mode, markdown_content, created_by, published_at, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.ccct_profiles WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT id, course_id, name, template_title, status, version, format_version, structured_current, last_mode, markdown_content, created_by, published_at, created_at, updated_at FROM edu.ccct_profiles WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu.ccct_profiles WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND lower(btrim(name)) = lower(btrim(#{name})) AND (#{excludedProfileId}::uuid IS NULL OR id != #{excludedProfileId}) )
SELECT id, profile_id, course_chapter_id, chapter_code, title, order_index FROM edu.ccct_chapters WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY order_index
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.ccct_profiles (id, course_id, name, template_title, status, version, format_version, structured_current, last_mode, markdown_content, created_by, published_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{courseId}, #{name}, #{templateTitle}, #{status, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.course.app.domain.CcctProfileStatus, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{version}, #{formatVersion}, #{structuredCurrent}, #{lastMode, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.course.app.domain.CcctMode, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{markdownContent}, #{createdBy}, #{publishedAt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.ccct_profiles SET name = #{profile.name}, template_title = #{profile.templateTitle}, format_version = #{profile.formatVersion}, structured_current = #{profile.structuredCurrent}, last_mode = #{profile.lastMode, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.course.app.domain.CcctMode, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, markdown_content = #{profile.markdownContent}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{profile.id} AND course_id = #{profile.courseId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO edu.ccct_chapters (id, profile_id, course_chapter_id, chapter_code, title, order_index) VALUES
(#{chapter.id}, #{chapter.profileId}, #{chapter.courseChapterId}, #{chapter.chapterCode}, #{chapter.title}, #{chapter.orderIndex})

INSERT INTO edu.ccct_items (id, chapter_id, content_code, content, order_index) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.chapterId}, #{item.contentCode}, #{item.content}, #{item.orderIndex})

INSERT INTO edu.ccct_chapters (id, profile_id, course_chapter_id, title, order_index) VALUES (#{chapter.id},#{chapter.profileId},#{chapter.courseChapterId},#{chapter.title},#{chapter.orderIndex}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET course_chapter_id=EXCLUDED.course_chapter_id,title=EXCLUDED.title,order_index=EXCLUDED.order_index

INSERT INTO edu.ccct_topics (id, profile_id, chapter_id, group_code, title, order_index) VALUES (#{topic.id},#{topic.profileId},#{topic.chapterId},#{topic.groupCode},#{topic.title},#{topic.orderIndex}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET chapter_id=EXCLUDED.chapter_id,group_code=EXCLUDED.group_code,title=EXCLUDED.title,order_index=EXCLUDED.order_index

INSERT INTO edu.ccct_items (id, topic_id, content_code, content, order_index) VALUES (#{item.id},#{item.topicId},#{item.contentCode},#{item.content},#{item.orderIndex}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET topic_id=EXCLUDED.topic_id,content_code=EXCLUDED.content_code,content=EXCLUDED.content,order_index=EXCLUDED.order_index
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM edu.ccct_items WHERE topic_id IN (SELECT id FROM edu.ccct_topics WHERE profile_id=#{profileId}) AND id NOT IN #{id}
DELETE FROM edu.ccct_topics WHERE profile_id=#{profileId} AND id NOT IN #{id}
DELETE FROM edu.ccct_chapters WHERE profile_id=#{profileId} AND id NOT IN #{id}
